sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v10_8_Pre_Time_Motion_Consistency_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
No physical time parameter is used.

The central ontology is

\[
\boxed{
\text{motion}\neq\text{pruning}\neq\text{entropy}\neq\text{time}.
}
\]

Motion is represented as a reversible relation between physical relational configurations.

A finite transformation

\[
x\longmapsto g\cdot x
\]

can change the physical quantum state, can compose with other transformations, and has an
inverse, without introducing a temporal arrow or elapsed-time interpretation.

The main theorem is that global quantum consistency imposes a synchronization law on such
motion.

Even if every individual relational edge undergoes a perfectly valid reversible quantum
transformation preserving its local spectrum, the transformed edge family may fail to be one
possible global quantum state if the motions assigned to shared subsystems disagree.

This gives a genuinely pre-time global motion constraint.

It is not yet gravity.

## 1. Motion without time

Let \(\mathcal A_G\) denote the globally admissible relational atlas.

A reversible motion is represented by an invertible group action

\[
g:\mathcal A_G\to\mathcal A_G.
\]

For a state \(x\),

\[
x'=g\cdot x
\]

means that \(x\) and \(x'\) are physically distinct configurations related by an allowed
reversible transformation.

No assertion is made that \(x'\) is temporally later than \(x\).

The group properties are

\[
g_2(g_1x)=(g_2g_1)x
\]

and

\[
g^{-1}(gx)=x.
\]

These give transformation composition and reversibility, not temporal order.

sources.excerpt:
## 7. Non-repair rule

Once pruning begins, the following are forbidden.

### No tuning \(g_\star\)

Pruning cannot choose \(g_\star\) to make later geometry fit observations.

### No retroactive UPSF derivation

A successful pruning/geometry limit cannot be used to claim UPSF was already derived pre-time.

### No temporal reinterpretation

The pre-time transformation parameter \(\lambda\) cannot be redefined retroactively as
fundamental physical time.

### No added attraction law

If attraction appears later, it must be derived from pruning/post-pruning structure rather than
inserted into the frozen pre-time generator.

### No connection replacement

Pruning cannot change the v10.14 transport rule merely because another transport produces a
preferred geometry.

### No source-composition rewrite

The order-free additive generator law remains frozen.

### No entropy back-propagation

Entropy or irreversible information loss cannot be invoked to explain any theorem already
classified as pre-time.

This rule is essential for scientific hygiene.
